name: readJsonl
reason: readJsonl reads files verify.js itself lists; a bad file should throw, which is what a check tool wants.

name: indexEntry
reason: indexEntry only gets convertFrames output, which always starts with a header naming p1 and p2 with source.pov and ends with an end event.

name: verifyGame
reason: verifyGame only runs on files main found with fs.existsSync; capture.seats is optional-chained; loop is bounded by the shorter list and length mismatch is reported.

name: main
reason: Deliberate: a bad input file is reported on stderr and sets exitCode 1 while the other files still import.

name: toTimeline
reason: Test-only writer; the one caller always passes a stamp per frame.

name: analyzeGame
reason: Pre-existing analyzeGame (PR #2) not changed here; views come from main, which always sets them.

name: main
reason: main checks the dir argument; JSON.stringify(undefined) is guarded with ?.; results are built by verifyGame.
